svg.title: Enterprise private-connectivity pattern
svg.desc: A simplified adaptation of Microsoft's baseline Foundry chat architecture, not a replacement for its full network design. Service icons on the right represent managed PaaS resources. They are not depicted as compute deployed inside the workload VNet.

text.tspan: Enterprise reference - separate cost profile | REFERENCE DESIGN - NOT DEPLOYED
Solid: primary flow / semantic relationship Dashed: supporting evidence, control or return
Public Microsoft sources: MS03, MS14 | See companion documentation for scope and exclusions.
